description: Portfolio oversight: use this when a PE or VC operator wants a scorecard across all their portfolio companies, or asks which company is most at risk. Returns each company's Revenue Readiness Index, comparable across companies, with the average, the at-risk count and customer-concentration risk. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

portfolioId.description: The portfolio to roll up. whoami lists yours with their ids.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

name: get_portfolio_readiness_rollup
title: Portfolio readiness scorecard
